Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Stock Manager
Punchline: Balances Island Sanctuary stock with imported Visland routes.
Description: Choose Island resources and stock levels, then let Stock Manager select imported Visland routes. Supports sortable resources, farming priorities, flight and underwater navigation, a route map, mount override, stuck recovery, Lifestream, surplus export, run statistics, and /sm commands.
Changelog: Fixed flight-only route selection, swimming/dive navigation, and immediate surplus export checks. Completed Stop targets now leave the active set without restarting; export visits sell every configured surplus. Added a route map, sorting, priorities, mount override, stuck recovery, and clustered generated routes.
